techs.name: Flying Buttress

techs.name: Scientific Method
techs.description: Unlocks the laboratory building.

techs.name: Calculus
techs.description: Grants a :siege: unit and lowers all future :progress: thresholds by 8%.

techs.name: Chemistry
techs.description: Grants a :siege: unit. Siege units gain +1 range.

techs.name: Espionage
techs.description: Unlocks the decoy building.

techs.name: Replaceable Parts
techs.description: Unlocks the hangar and grants an :aerial: unit.

techs.name: Combustion
techs.description: Increases the :attack: of all units by 15. Grants a :naval: unit.

techs.name: Radio
techs.description: Increases the range of every ranged EFFECT by 1 — auras, command radii, building ranges.

techs.name: Flight
techs.description: Grants an :aerial: unit.

techs.name: Aerodynamics
techs.description: Grants an :aerial: unit. Aerial units gain +2 :speed:.

techs.name: Helicopters
techs.description: Increases the :attack: of :aerial: units by 25. Grants an aerial unit.

techs.name: Radar
techs.description: Grants a :ranged: unit. Ranged units deal +50% damage to :astral: and :aerial: units.

techs.name: Commercial Air Travel
techs.description: Unlocks the airport and grants an :aerial: unit.

techs.name: Supersonics
techs.description: Grants an :aerial: unit. Aerial units gain +2 :speed:.

techs.name: Automation
techs.description: Unlocks the skunkworks building.

techs.name: Satellites
techs.description: Grants an :astral: unit.

techs.name: Microprocessors
techs.description: Increases the length of each era by 5 ticks.

techs.name: Cloud Computing
techs.description: Unlocks the data center building.

techs.name: Artificial General Intelligence
techs.description: All outputs +10%, but the enemy budget grows 25% faster.

techs.name: Butlerian Jihad
techs.description: All outputs −10%, but the enemy budget grows 25% slower.

techs.name: Stealth
techs.description: Grants an :aerial: unit. Aerial units have a 25% chance to avoid an incoming attack.

techs.name: Railguns
techs.description: Grants a :ranged: unit. Ranged units gain +30 :attack:.

techs.name: High Fidelity Combat Sims
techs.description: Every 20 ticks, all units gain +1 :attack:.

techs.name: Cloning
techs.description: Whenever a city gains a citizen, it gains a second one.

techs.name: Semaglutides
techs.description: Decreases all future :food: thresholds by 20%.

techs.name: 3D Printing
techs.description: Unlocks the 3D printer building.

techs.name: Fracking
techs.description: Reduces the base yield of every rural tile by 1, but increases all yields by 10%.

techs.name: Renewable Energy
techs.description: Unlocks the hydroelectric dam, the solar panel farm and the geothermal plant — one per terrain.

techs.name: Solar Sails
techs.description: Grants an :astral: unit. Astral units gain +1 :speed:.

techs.name: Orbital Assembly
techs.description: Unlocks the spaceport, placed adjacent to a planetary tile.

techs.name: Orbital Bombardment
techs.description: Grants an :astral: unit. Astral range over planet tiles increases by 2.

techs.name: Bimodal Starcraft
techs.description: Grants an :aerial: unit. Aerial units may move into space tiles.

techs.name: Deep Space Industry
techs.description: Unlocks the zero-G fabricator.

techs.name: Gravity Boots
techs.description: Unlocks the zero-G laboratory.

techs.name: Helium-3
techs.description: Unlocks the helium-3 mine, buildable on the Moon or Mars.

techs.name: Fusion Power
techs.description: Unlocks the fusion plant.

techs.name: Rapid Reconstruction
techs.description: Enemies can no longer raze your buildings.

techs.name: Warp Drive
techs.description: Grants an :astral: unit. Astral units have infinite :speed:.

techs.name: Von Neumann Craft
techs.description: Grants an :astral: unit — and another at the end of every combat.

techs.name: Tightbeams
techs.description: Unlocks the interplanetary beacon — built in pairs, they weld two distant neighbourhoods into one.

techs.name: Biological Immortality
techs.description: Doubles :food: output everywhere. :melee: and :ranged: units gain +25 :defense:.

techs.name: Cortical Stacks
techs.description: All :food: output becomes :gold:. Each combat ends with 3 expansion events, and a fallen unit respawns 10 turns later on a tile you control.

techs.name: Consciousness Upload
techs.description: Cities grow enormously faster, but every tile produces 1 less :production:.

techs.name: Biological Ascendancy
techs.description: Military units gain +25% :attack: and +25% :defense:. All future :food: thresholds rise 10%.

techs.name: Human Purity
techs.description: Every Earth tile gains +1 base yield; every non-Earth base yield is halved.

techs.name: Planetogenesis
techs.description: Creates a planet tile and immediately puts an outpost on it.

techs.name: Artificial Singularity
techs.description: Creates a singularity tile and puts an outpost on it. Enemies moving beside a singularity take 5% :defense: damage.

techs.name: Tachyons
techs.description: Grants a :ranged: unit. Ranged units have infinite range; enemies inside their ordinary range take double damage instead.

techs.name: Time Travel
techs.description: Doubles the length of every era.

techs.name: Timeline Erasure
techs.description: Removes up to 5 tiles from the game entirely — no movement, no yield, gone.

techs.name: Chronomancy
techs.description: Grants a :utility: command unit. Units in its command radius attack an extra time every third attack.

techs.name: Molecular Duplication
techs.description: Unlocks the replicator building.

techs.name: Quantum Construction
techs.description: Whenever you place a building, an identical second copy is placed with it.

techs.name: Recursive Self Improvement
techs.description: Whenever you upgrade a unit or building, it is upgraded a second time.

wonders.name: Parthenon
wonders.description: Counts as a temple. Increases temple output by 30%. Requires Monotheism or Polytheism.

wonders.name: Terracotta Army
wonders.description: Receive a melee unit, a cavalry unit, a ranged unit and a command unit. Command units gain 25% effect.

wonders.name: Colossus of Rhodes
wonders.description: Offered only if you control a coastal tile adjacent to ocean. Receive 2 naval units. Reduce upgrade costs on naval units by 50%.

wonders.name: Colosseum
wonders.description: End-of-combat effects happen an additional time.

wonders.name: Mausoleum of Halicarnassus
wonders.description: Whenever any one of your units dies, increase the progress on this wonder by 1.

wonders.name: Forbidden Palace
wonders.description: Produces the same outputs as your palace and participates in combat with the same status as the palace.

wonders.name: Hagia Sophia
wonders.description: Counts as a temple. On completion produces 2 temples. Requires Monotheism or Polytheism.

wonders.name: Great Wall
wonders.description: On completion, create 2 fortification units on adjacent tiles if possible. Fortifications have +15 defense.

wonders.name: Duomo
wonders.description: All buildings get +1 upgrade level.

wonders.name: Venetian Arsenal
wonders.description: Naval units have +100% attack. Create a naval unit on completion.

wonders.name: Statue of Liberty
wonders.description: Significantly increases city growth rate.

wonders.name: Taj Mahal
wonders.description: Whenever a unit dies, it permanently gains +10 attack and +10 defense.

wonders.name: Eiffel Tower
wonders.description: Whenever you complete a wonder, including this one, receive a free progress.

wonders.name: Manhattan Project
wonders.description: Receive a siege unit. Siege units get +3 range, +1 blast radius and +30 attack. However when a siege unit attacks, targeted tiles are razed.

wonders.name: Big Ben
wonders.description: Increase all gold outputs by 50%.

wonders.name: Sagrada Familia
wonders.description: Counts as a temple but produces 400% output.

wonders.name: Burj Khalifa
wonders.description: Citizens in cities each produce an additional progress, production and gold.

wonders.name: Sydney Opera House
wonders.description: Coast only. Increase progress yields of all tiles by 25%.

wonders.name: International Space Station
wonders.description: Can be built only in space. Produces +500 progress.

wonders.name: United Nations
wonders.description: Mercenaries you hire get +5 upgrade levels.

wonders.name: Space Elevator
wonders.description: On completion gain 2 astral units. All astral units create +5 production.

wonders.name: Skynet
wonders.description: On completion gain a melee unit. Melee units deal double damage. All thresholds increased by 10.

wonders.name: Great Desalinator
wonders.description: Coastal only. Increases food yields of all coastal tiles by 3.

wonders.name: Lunar Defense Station
wonders.description: All units on the Moon get +150% attack and +1 range.

wonders.name: Happy Valley
wonders.description: Requires Mars capability, Mars only. Increase yields of all Mars tiles by 100%.

wonders.name: Generation Ship
wonders.description: Space placement only. Your first outpost on the exoplanet is immediately converted into a city with population 15.

wonders.name: Elysium
wonders.description: Counts as a city. Whenever a friendly unit dies, add it to the city's population.

wonders.name: Ceres Station
wonders.description: Space only. Double output from asteroids, stars and singularities.

wonders.name: Planetary Shield
wonders.description: Whenever an enemy enters Earth, they take 10% defense damage.

wonders.name: Panopticon
wonders.description: You may pay gold to reposition enemy units, just as you do player units.

wonders.name: The Ansible
wonders.description: Gain a command unit. All ranged effects get +1 range.

wonders.name: Stargate
wonders.description: Buildings may be repositioned freely.

wonders.name: Museum of Humanity
wonders.description: All buildings get +1 progress for every combat they have existed for.

wonders.name: Golden Lion Throne
wonders.description: Your palace produces +500 of all outputs.

wonders.name: Death Star
wonders.description: Space only. Every 5 turns, instantly kill a random enemy unit.

wonders.name: Galactic Senate
wonders.description: Space only. Before combat, gain a mercenary for free adjacent to the Galactic Senate and all planets you control.

wonders.name: White Hole Station
wonders.description: Singularity only. All units may be placed on singularities. At the start of combat they get double range, attack, defense and speed, but their position is randomized to an empty valid tile on the map.

wonders.name: Dimensional Rift
wonders.description: You deal +50% damage to the final enemy while the rift is not destroyed.

wonders.name: Monument of Ozymandias
wonders.description: Your palace has 1 defense. You control all tiles in the galaxy.

buildings.name: Temple
buildings.description: The religion building. On its own it does little — nearly every religious node adds another output or multiplier to EVERY temple you own, so they are meant to be stacked.

buildings.name: Library
buildings.description: Produces +1 :progress: per tick, and another +1 after every combat it survives. Razing it resets the accumulation.

buildings.name: Market
buildings.description: Every citizen within range 3 produces +1 :gold:.

buildings.name: Observatory
buildings.description: Mountain only. Produces +1 :progress:, and gains another +1 permanently every time you reroll an offer.

buildings.name: Granary
buildings.description: Doubles the base :food: yield of every plains tile in range 1.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.description: Produces +16 :production: per tick.

buildings.name: Wharf
buildings.description: Produces 18 :food: per tick.

buildings.name: Monument
buildings.description: Produces +15 :progress: per tick.

buildings.name: Harbor
buildings.description: Gives +1 base :gold: yield to every connected water tile.

buildings.name: Plantation
buildings.description: Produces +1 :food:, and permanently +1 more every 20 ticks.

buildings.name: Theater
buildings.description: Produces +5 :progress: per tick — flat, immediate, and never grows.

buildings.name: Aqueduct
buildings.description: Placed between a mountain and a city. The city it feeds has its citizens produce :food: as well as their usual output.

buildings.name: Glassworks
buildings.description: Every building within range 1 gains +5 :production: output.

buildings.name: Hacienda
buildings.description: Built in the New World. Gives every New World tile +4 :gold:.

buildings.name: Courthouse
buildings.description: Raises the output of every tile in range 1 by 10%.

buildings.name: Bank
buildings.description: At the end of each combat, pays 7% interest on the :gold: you are holding — so it rewards not spending.

buildings.name: Opera House
buildings.description: Raises the :progress: yield of every tile in range 1 by 50%.

buildings.name: Laboratory
buildings.description: Raises the :progress: output of every tile in range 3 by 50%.

buildings.name: Colonial Office
buildings.description: Built in the New World. Produces +1 :gold: per tick for every New World outpost you control.

buildings.name: Megafarm
buildings.description: Produces :food: equal to all the :food: produced within its range — it copies a breadbasket rather than making one.

buildings.name: Skunkworks
buildings.description: Produces +1 :production:, and gains +2 permanently every time you reroll an offer.

buildings.name: Casino
buildings.description: Produces +1 :gold:, and gains +3 permanently every time you reroll an offer.

buildings.name: Interplanetary Beacon
buildings.description: Built in pairs. Every building adjacent to one beacon counts as adjacent to every building next to the other — adjacency across the solar system.

buildings.name: Helium-3 Mine
buildings.description: Moon or Mars only. Produces +70 :production: per tick.

buildings.name: Data Center
buildings.description: Grants +100% :gold: output to every land tile in range 3.

buildings.name: Fusion Plant
buildings.description: Raises the upgrade level of every unit and building in range 1 by 3.

buildings.name: Zero-G Fabricator
buildings.description: Produces +10 :production: for every empty space tile in range 2 — it wants to be surrounded by nothing.

buildings.name: Zero-G Laboratory
buildings.description: Produces +10 :progress: for every empty space tile in range 2.

buildings.name: Stock Exchange
buildings.description: Produces +1 :gold: for every citizen in your empire.

buildings.name: Hospital
buildings.description: Citizens in cities within range 5 each produce +1 :food:.

buildings.name: Museum
buildings.description: Gives +5 :progress: and +5 :gold: for every building in range 3 that was built BEFORE it — a reward for building it late.

buildings.name: Decoy
buildings.description: Enemies within range 5 path to the decoy instead of your palace. Once they reach it they reroute — it buys turns, not safety.

buildings.name: Spaceport
buildings.description: Placed adjacent to a planetary tile. Every 10 turns of combat it creates an :astral: unit beside it, and gives +1 :gold: to all astral units.

buildings.name: Replicator
buildings.description: Every 10 turns of combat, creates a temporary copy of the unit standing on it.

buildings.name: Guildhall
buildings.description: Produces +3 :gold: for every UNIQUE building in your empire — it pays for variety, not quantity.

buildings.name: Armory
buildings.description: Every unit in range 1 gains +5 :defense: permanently after each combat.

buildings.name: Windmill
buildings.description: Doubles the output of every adjacent rural tile.

buildings.name: University
buildings.description: Produces +2 :progress: for each adjacent citizen.

buildings.name: Arena
buildings.description: At the end of each combat the arena permanently gains +50 :gold: of output and you receive +250 :gold:.

buildings.name: Factory
buildings.description: Produces +20 :production: per tick.

buildings.name: Tourism Office
buildings.description: Produces +25 :gold: for every adjacent wonder.

buildings.name: Airport
buildings.description: Produces +5 :gold: and +5 :production: for every :aerial: unit in range 3.

buildings.name: Hangar
buildings.description: When an :aerial: unit dies within range 10, it respawns beside the hangar 10 turns later.

buildings.name: 3D Printer
buildings.description: On completion, immediately puts an outpost on every adjacent rural tile, claiming them if it must. Raises the yield of outposts in range 3 by 50%.

buildings.name: Hydroelectric Dam
buildings.description: Coast not adjacent to ocean only. Gives +1 upgrade level to every unit and building in range 1.

buildings.name: Solar Panel Farm
buildings.description: Desert only. Gives +1 upgrade level to every unit and building in range 1.

buildings.name: Geothermal Plant
buildings.description: Tundra only. Gives +1 upgrade level to every unit and building in range 1.

unitClasses.name: Melee
unitClasses.description: Slow, but strong. Closes with the nearest enemy and holds the line.

unitClasses.name: Ranged
unitClasses.description: Least :defense: and :attack: of anything that fights. Never advances — it shoots from where you put it.

unitClasses.name: Cavalry
unitClasses.description: Fast, not as strong. Reaches a breach in a single turn.

unitClasses.name: Siege
unitClasses.description: Heavy hitter with a long reach and a blast radius of 1. Does not move once placed.

unitClasses.name: Naval
unitClasses.description: Water only, in both senses: it is built on water and it never leaves it.

unitClasses.name: Aerial
unitClasses.description: Very fast, and crosses water freely. Planet-bound until a tech grants it space.

unitClasses.name: Astral
unitClasses.description: Space only — the void and the bodies in it. Cannot come down to a planet until a tech lets it.

unitClasses.name: Command
unitClasses.description: INTRINSIC: never attacks. Buffs every friendly unit inside its radius of 2.

unitClasses.name: Fortification
unitClasses.description: INTRINSIC: never attacks, never moves, and taunts every enemy in reach. A wall with hit points.
